p0Blockers.title: Enable ComputerEase API Access
p0Blockers.clientAction: Contact Deltek support to enable API access for ComputerEase, configure the CE Live Service relay, and confirm API version compatibility (v26 or higher).
p0Blockers.body: The client needs to submit a vendor support ticket to Deltek to enable API access for ComputerEase and configure the CE Live Service relay. It is crucial to verify API version compatibility (v26+) and ensure sandbox/production parity for testing and deployment.

p0Blockers.title: Harden GCP Firewall Rules for ComputerEase VM
p0Blockers.clientAction: Work with your IT team or GCP administrator to harden firewall rules for the ComputerEase VM, restricting SSH/RDP access to only necessary IP addresses and configuring network isolation.
p0Blockers.body: The current GCP firewall rules allow SSH and RDP access from anywhere, which is a significant security vulnerability. Firewall rules must be hardened to restrict SSH/RDP access to authorized sources only, and network isolation should be configured for the ComputerEase VM to enhance security.

p0Blockers.title: Verify Salesforce API User Permissions and Admin Access
p0Blockers.clientAction: Confirm that the designated Salesforce API user has the necessary permissions for integration and that an administrator has full access to configure API integrations.
p0Blockers.body: Before any Salesforce integration, it is essential to verify that the API user has appropriate permissions and that an administrator has full access to configure API integrations. This includes confirming sandbox environment parity with production and establishing a read-only API user for ComputerEase data sync to prevent unintended modifications.

p0Blockers.title: Obtain Home Depot Service Center Portal API Credentials
p0Blockers.clientAction: Contact the Home Depot Portal team (Marius) to obtain API credentials for the lead generation API and discuss webhook or polling mechanisms for real-time lead updates.
p0Blockers.body: API credentials are required from the Home Depot Portal team (Marius) to access the lead generation API. The client needs to configure the lead generation API for a 10-minute sync frequency and establish a webhook or polling mechanism for real-time lead updates to ensure data freshness.

p0Blockers.title: Configure DocHub for Digital Signature Capture and API Access
p0Blockers.clientAction: Configure DocHub to capture digital signatures for contract types 299A, 299B, and 118, and establish a document storage and retrieval API for Salesforce integration.
p0Blockers.body: DocHub needs to be configured to support digital signature capture for specific contract types (299A, 299B, 118). Additionally, a document storage and retrieval API must be established to facilitate integration with Salesforce for seamless document management.

pricing.recommendedModelRationale: Peerless Fence is an SMB operating brand within a PE-backed platform (Elevate Fence Partners). The integration scope spans 6+ systems (HD Portal, Salesforce, ComputerEase, DocHub, GCP, Deltek) with heavy manual data entry and no evidence of in-house MuleSoft development capability. IaaS model with managed connectors and pre-built templates will accelerate time-to-value and reduce operational overhead for this resource-constrained team.
